items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: we played three or four circuits, Considine, Sullivan Considine, and we worked out of Chicago... We went from here to Chicago and we had a fella handle our act

ctx.x: How far did you get out on the off-air circuit?

Well, we were two years, we played three or four circuits, Considine, Sullivan Considine, and we worked out of Chicago, you see. We went from here to Chicago and we had a fella handle our act, an agent, and he sent us from one place to another. We played Kansas City about four weeks in those days. Played Chicago, all the parks and everything like that. And, yeah.
